page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with an inscription in capitals at the top and a footnote-style explanatory paragraph below it; a catchword-style word "CAP." at the lower right. Page number at top left, running head centred and right.

main_text.l: Characteres hic inscriptos sic explicamus: Pro Libertate
dedit Sestertia 50000; nam ista figura eadem est quæ
IƆƆƆ, utpote quæ tres etiam C inversas ad dextram habet.
Pro Seviratu dedit Sestertia 2000. In Statuas ponendas
in ædem Herculis dedit Sestertia 30000; nam & iste cha-
racter ⋔ idem est qui CCIƆƆ raptim scriptus. In vias
sternendas dedit Sestertia 37000. Patrimonii denique re-
liquit Sestertia undeviginti millia, sive 19000; nam cha-
racter millenarius ∞ reliquis præpositus se iis detrahit.
Quod & in minoribus numeris antea observatum est.

page.notes: Several inscribed numeral characters are symbolic glyphs (ancient numerals with strokes and loops) that cannot be reproduced exactly; they are rendered approximately. The "19000" in the footnote is uncertain and may be a printing error for 19000 or similar. Running head reads "Arithmetices" and "Lib.I."; the word "CAP." at lower right is a catchword-like signature, shown in the bottom margin in the original.
